propositions: Under pytest xdist with -n 3 --dist worksteal, the process-local lru_cache on _rendered() is duplicated across three workers, causing all 178 corpus bodies to be rendered three times instead of once, wasting ~56s of CPU
The three test_dc_corpus_passes_two_to_five_are_byte_identical tests independently recompute pass-1 renders that _rendered() has already cached, duplicating ~12s of work across the three tests

A session-scoped cross-worker artifact keyed by SHA-256 digest of corpus JSON files, wiki_render source, and pandoc executable can replace the process-local cache and be shared safely via os.mkdir locking

Sharding the shared artifact per stratum and probing in a PYTEST_XDIST_WORKER-rotated order allows concurrent workers to fill different shards concurrently, reducing cold-session wall time from full-corpus cost to one stratum

The loser fallback deadline of 150s below --timeout=300 ensures a worker blocked on a crashed winner can break the orphaned lock, render locally, and finish inside the timeout guard instead of deadlocking
